question: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) increased the Minimum Support Prices (MSPs) of cotton (long staple) to Rs _______ per quintal for marketing season 2020-21.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Rs 5825/-__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
The** Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by PM Narendra Modi, has approved the increase in the Minimum Support Prices (MSPs) for all mandated Kharif crops for marketing season 2020-21.**

 
 
• 
 
The government has increased the **MSP of Kharif crops for marketing season 2020-21**, to ensure remunerative prices to the growers for their produce. 

 
 
• The **price fixed for Cotton (Long Staple) and cotton (Medium Staple) **is** Rs 5825 and Rs 5515 for the year 2020-21.**
 
• The **MSP was further** increased for the **Cotton (Long Staple) from Rs 5825 to Rs 6025 for the year 2021-22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CCEA **has the mandate to **review economic trends on a continuous basis,** as also the problems and prospects, with a view to evolving a consistent and integrated economic policy framework for the country.
 
• Apart from the above functions, the **committee also directs and coordinates all policies and activities in the field of economics.**
 
• **Price controls **of industrial raw materials and products,** industrial licensing policies **including industrial licensing cases for the establishment of Joint Sector Undertakings, **reviewing the performance of Public Sector Undertakings including their structural and financial restructuring **
 
• The Committee is **chaired by the PM and it consists of the Ministers as its member.**
